reading.zh: 从底向上读：storage 是块设备、文件系统、容器与数据服务；execution 在其上提供执行平面；governance 是能力门禁；vscript 是可执行脚本语言；cli 是用户入口；contracts 是被各方实现的抽象契约；接着是对外一组——Agent 工作区与沙箱、导出面、以及沉底的平台适配层；examples/tests/docs/delivery 是示例、保障与交付。
reading.en: Read bottom-up: storage holds block devices, filesystems, containers and data services; execution layers the execution plane on top; governance is the capability gate; vscript is the executable script language; cli is the user entry; contracts are the abstractions others implement; then the outward-facing group -- the agent workspace and its sandbox, the exported API, and the platform layer everything sits on; examples/docs/tests/delivery provide assurance and delivery.

title.zh: 对外接口与 Agent 入口
